query: Add Phaseo to our FastAPI service using the official Python SDK.
expected_behavior: Creates one shared Phaseo client with api_key from os.environ["PHASEO_API_KEY"]
Uses generate_response for new text work

query: My Jupyter notebook has the Phaseo key pasted in a cell. Clean this up.
expected_behavior: Moves the key to an environment variable
Warns that a committed key must be rotated

query: Submit a batch of 500 prompts through Phaseo from Python and collect the results.
expected_behavior: Uses client.batches.create and persists the batch ID
Polls until a terminal state with bounded backoff
Uses the TypeScript SDK skill, not the Python one
